state: Goal `core-str-2-3`: `Core\Str::graphemes`, `indexOf`, `isEmpty`, `join`, `lastIndexOf`, `lines`, `lower`, `lowerFirst`, `normalize`, `padStart`, `padEnd` and `repeat` are complete (`bun nv proofs --id` says so for each). The `2/3` check now names only `replace` with no proofs. `normalize` now builds its result through `normalized`, which asks `nvs_runtime::affordable` at every doubling of the buffer. Before that, a compatibility form of a text of `ﷺ` built a result eleven times the text, with no ask, before the copy into an `NvsStr`. Every `Core\IO` and `Core\Str` perf record was re-measured this session. Gaps `nvs-stdlib/a-match-inside-a-character-reports-the-wrong-position` and `nvs-stdlib/case-conversion-builds-its-result-outside-the` (both M12) are open. Any change to the code of `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/str.rs` makes every `Core\Str` perf record stale; a change to `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/io.rs` does the same for every `Core\IO`, `Core\IO\File` and `Core\IO\Metadata` record. Re-measure them all in the same session with `bun nv proofs --record-perf --only …`, naming each bench under `benches/members/core/Str/` (except `length.scale`) or `benches/members/core/IO*/`. A change to a card or a test does not make a record stale.
